📍 Language models

Embedding

In simple words

A list of numbers that stands for a word, picture or other thing, so that similar things get similar numbers.

A way of turning a word (or a token, a picture, a song) into a list of numbers, like a point on a map with many directions. Things with similar meanings end up close together, so the computer can measure how alike two things are. Language models turn every token into an embedding before working with it.

Example. On such a map, “cat” lands near “kitten” and “dog”, and far from “bicycle”. A music app can use the same trick to find songs that sound like your favourites.

Related words

  • TokenA small piece of text, such as a word or part of a word, that a language model reads and writes.
  • ClusteringGrouping similar things together without being told what the groups are.
  • Natural language processing (NLP)The area of AI that works with human language: understanding, translating and creating text or speech.
